analysis.reason: RSI 77.9로 과매수 구간 진입, 5일 전 70.8 대비 상승세 지속. MACD 히스토그램 10.8976으로 개선세 유지. 5일 연속 양봉 마감하며 52주 신고가 경신 가능성. ADX 29.6으로 뚜렷한 추세 확인.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (10.4040→10.8976): 개선세 유지 + 강세 확산
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (상단 $721.19): 상단 돌파 + 강세 확장 구간

· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세): RSI 과매수 진입에도 추세 지속 가능성, 731.00 지지선 확보 시 매수 진입 유효
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($741.25) vs SMA5/20/50($686.15/$623.71/$608.35): Short- to mid-term trend above moving averages confirmed.
· Position vs SMA100/200($603.98/$623.54): Strong mid- to long-term trend.
· 52-week Position (88.3%) + Approaching historical high price zone.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (70.8→77.9): Entering overbought + Momentum strengthening.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (10.4040→10.8976): Improvement maintained + Bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Upper $721.19): Breaking upper band + Bullish expansion zone.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($731.00): Close to current price.
· Swing Resistance ($744.00): Potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low recovery continues): Uptrend strengthening.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (2.44x 5-day average): Strong buying pressure confirmed.
· Current Zone Diagnosis (Uptrend): Potential for continued trend despite RSI overbought, valid buy entry if $731.00 support holds.
